pages.text: Each chapter of the Anomaly storyline now has something to meet, not only to read. $(thing)Abnormality & Infection$(): the containment-failure creatures infect (Fracture, Grey Goo, Rewind, Hollowing). $(thing)Broken Symmetry$(): the Destabilised Husk's Fracture. $(thing)Molecules That Copy Themselves$() and $(thing)Self-Reference$(): the Nanite Swarm's Grey Goo. $(thing)Pathological Objects$(): the Paradox Echo's Rewind.

$(thing)Oncogenesis$(): the Tumour of Inner Space, its oncogenic field, and the Tumour Hydra. $(thing)Evasion$(): Metastasis, which plain wards miss. $(thing)Clonal Evolution$(): resistance, as each antibiotic dose on a machine selects what survives it. $(thing)The Microenvironment$(): Inner Space's inflammation and its macrophages.

$(thing)Epidemics$(): infections pass between players. Each second an infected player passes theirs on, one time in fifty, to anyone within four blocks who is not warded: the SIR model played out, and a ward is herd immunity. $(thing)Where Anomaly Meets Normality$(): the Law Wraiths, reality's own antibodies (Tolerance makes them leave you be). $(thing)Symbiosis$(): the Probiotic Seal and the Symbiont Lining.
$(thing)Containment$() and $(thing)Targeted Therapy$(): the Containment Ward, and the CAR-T Cell Culture that seals the Tumour Hydra's stumps. $(thing)Resolution$(): the Resolution Engine, as before.
